changeLog.rationale: Story 6.2 consumes (deletes) the Conversations-owned ServiceDefaults marker project — every file under the accepted 'src/Hexalith.Conversations.ServiceDefaults/**' path. Platform EventStore.ServiceDefaults now owns the generic hosting capability, while the non-shipping Conversations AppHost consumes that public surface. With the local project removed, the accepted glob resolves to no .cs file. Does 'service-defaults-greenfield' remain Promote?
changeLog.resolutionRationale: Upheld — classification stays Promote. Removing the local marker realizes the accepted promotion/adoption call and does not rewrite the signed-v1 row, path, or 13-LOC estimate. This additive Story 6.2 disposition is bound to the signed inventory hash and its deletion claim is re-derived from the recorded git baseline and candidate, independently of Story 6.2's mutable projection proof.
